title: goes at the next edit of the section
why: Put back's slot not cleared by a change: it stays beside an edit made since the reset, and pressing it would silently undo that edit as well, which is a second step of history the record of issue 561 refuses.

title: puts back what the map was drawn from, in one redraw
why: The reset keeping nothing: the values the map was drawn from are gone from the record and the screen at the first press, as they were before issue 561.

title: goes when the reset’s own redraw stops
why: A stopped reset leaving Put back offered: the record still holds the values, the control is back to them, and Put back offers to restore what nothing took away.

title: puts back what the map was drawn from when the reset is drawn, not when it was pressed
why: The slot kept only at the press: a reset held behind the panel's own redraw keeps the drawn from before that redraw, and Put back then undoes the change the map showed as well as the reset.

title: stays when a panel closes with no gesture under it
why: Every release taken as an edit: the colour panel the reset closed reports its close a task later, and Put back goes under the focus the reset handed it.

find:
if (drawn !== null && !facts.same(drawn, next))
      setKept({ id: facts.project.id, value: drawn, going: false })
title: keeps its values through Reset, Put back and Reset again during the first redraw
why: The slot cleared as the reset is drawn when drawn already is the reset's own: Reset, Put back and Reset again during the first redraw loses the values kept at the first press.

title: stays offered when Put back’s own redraw stops
why: A stop of Put back's own redraw forgetting the slot: a cancelled or failed Put back loses the values before the reset for good.
